structured.answer: If I have to pick, I'd take the second drawing, the one that groups everything by company. Under one name I knew, like Harel, I could see all its tracks. That included things I understand, like "אג"ח סחיר" and "כספי (שקלי)", each with its fee next to it. The first drawing opens straight on "עוקב מדד S&P 500", English letters and shares, and that isn't for me. I never got to the third one they marked "מומלץ". Before I put money anywhere, I'd ask you or the bank.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the three numbered tabs at the top
stuck.why: I didn't understand at first that '1. החברה בראש השורה', '2. קיבוץ לפי חברה' and '3. טבלת חברות מול סוגים' were the drawings I was meant to compare. They looked like part of the site.
It opens with 'עוקב מדד s&p 500'. English letters and shares. Nothing about safe saving, and I wanted to leave.
A second copy of the page started, and I wasn't sure whether this was a new drawing or the same page again.
So many rows of percentages and little circles. I got tired and stopped after screen 6.

The group line at the top of each company: 'הראל 16 מסלולים · נכסים 19.1 מיליארד ₪ · דמי ניהול מהחיסכון: מ־0.54% עד 0.61%'

עוקב מדד, as in what מדד means here
חשיפה בסוף ספטמבר 2026 with 'מניות' and 'מט"ח' percentages
The yellow and blue circles next to the percentages
'פחות מ־3 שנים' in place of a return

A plain sentence saying which track is safe or doesn't lose

What the third, 'recommended', drawing looks like, because I didn't get that far

findings.what: The page opens with S&P 500 and shares. For someone looking for safe saving, it feels like it isn't for me.
The dark background with thin grey text is hard to read even enlarged. The explanation lines are small and pale.
findings.where: All screens, especially the notes under the tables and the column headings

findings.what: Too many numbers in each row: two fees, two exposures, two returns, assets and a fund number. It makes me anxious.
It isn't clear the numbered tabs are separate options to compare. The 'מומלץ' option is only reached far down.
Returns like 24.04% look tempting, but there's no plain sentence about risk or about losing money.
The little circles and the two close colours (blue for shares, yellow for מט"ח) are hard to tell apart.
English letters are written differently each time (S&P500, s&p 500, S&P 500), which adds to the confusion.
Grouping by company is easier for me, because I look for a name I trust, and the fee range for the whole company sits on one line.
findings.where: Screen 4, 'קיבוץ לפי: חברה', and the line under 'הראל'
